difficulty_reason: Induction on closed subvarieties controls two comparison twists; stability of higher cohomology yields a section, and stabilization of H^1 across its divisor gives global generation and hence ampleness.
source_caveats: The proof cites ampleness on reduced components (18.8.A–B), the dimension-one criterion (19.2.H) and the base-point-free positive-on-curves criterion (18.4.O). The projective version is selected. The proper generalization in 20.4.2 is a citation.
